Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class JdbcBulkProposalStore

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.JdbcBulkProposalStore
public final class JdbcBulkProposalStore extends Object
Append-only protected input storage. It does not evaluate, authorize, admit or execute a proposal.

  • Constructor Details

    • JdbcBulkProposalStore

      public JdbcBulkProposalStore(BulkExecutionInfrastructure infrastructure)

  • Method Details

    • insert

      public void insert(BulkStoredProposal proposal)
      Returned insertion is provisional until the owning transaction commits. Duplicate IDs are conflicts.

    • insertEvaluated

      public void insertEvaluated(BulkEvaluationSnapshot evaluation)
      Persists protected input and its immutable evaluation evidence in the caller's one required transaction. A companion failure marks that transaction rollback-only, including when a caller later catches the safe storage exception.

    • find

      public Optional<BulkStoredProposal> find(BulkFingerprintContext scope, UUID id)
      Scope comes from trusted server context. Current grants/policy/expiry must still be checked by the caller.

    • findEvaluation

      public Optional<BulkEvaluationSnapshot> findEvaluation(BulkFingerprintContext scope, UUID id)
      Reads evidence only after the trusted, scope-bound protected input has been recovered. It remains evidence of facts and plans; callers must independently revalidate policy, grants, expiry and execution admission.
